paragraphs: In the morning, prepare and mix powders and adjust proportions. At midday, load molds, fill them, and compact the material. In the afternoon, remove pieces, trim edges, and inspect defects. Review temperature and pressure and make several adjustments. Before leaving, organize parts and records for the next day.

In short, they press powdered materials into parts. Work includes mixing materials, loading molds, compacting, removing pieces, and inspecting defects. Combining judgment with hands-on work, they form a foundation of manufacturing.
